title: "Figure 3 - SRSF2-mutant AML cohort overview"
output: html_document

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(ggbeeswarm)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(grid)
  library(qs2)
})

## =========================================================
## Paths
## =========================================================
PROJECT_DIR <- "/path/to/project"
OBJ_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "objects")
OUTDIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "plots/figure3")
dir.create(OUTDIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## =========================================================
## Inputs
##   - obj:        preprocessing/scrna/07_bonemarrowmap_annotation.R
##   - wes_info:   preprocessing/wes/04_wes_variant_filtering.Rmd
##   - srsf2_nano: nanoranger calls of the SRSF2 cohort (preprocessing/nanoranger_srsf2)
## =========================================================
obj        <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(OBJ_DIR, "ext_obj_merge_filt_doublets_removed_norm_scaled_scvi_bonemarmap_passonly_finalanno.qs2"))
wes_info   <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(OBJ_DIR, "wes_info.qs2"))
srsf2_nano <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(OBJ_DIR, "ext_srsf2_nano_combined_filtered.qs2"))

## =========================================================
## Shared cell-type colors (BoneMarrowMap broad final annotation)
## =========================================================
celltype_colors <- c(
  "HSCs"                 = "#d24163",
  "GMPs"                 = "#4d8445",
  "Lymphoid progenitors" = "#3e2664",
  "MEPs"                 = "darkorange",
  "Erythroid-like cells" = "#bd7533",
  "Monocytes"            = "#5bb94d",
  "T-cells"              = "#8DA0CB",
  "B-cells"              = "#A6761D",
  "NK cells"             = "#c959ad",
  "Dendritic cells"      = "#a1af47",
  "Plasma cells"         = "brown",
  "Stromal cells"        = "#A6CEE3"
)

## =========================================================
## Per-cell SRSF2 genotype (nanoranger) -> obj$SRSF2_genotype_nano
## =========================================================
srsf2_long <- srsf2_nano %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene == "SRSF2", mutated %in% c("mutated", "wildtype")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bc = as.character(bc)) %>%
  dplyr::select(bc, mutated) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

srsf2_calls <- srsf2_long %>%
  dplyr::arrange(bc, dplyr::desc(mutated == "mutated")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(bc, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(bc, SRSF2_genotype_nano = mutated)

obj$SRSF2_genotype_nano <- "unknown"
idx  <- match(srsf2_calls$bc, rownames(obj@meta.data))
keep <- which(!is.na(idx))
obj$SRSF2_genotype_nano[idx[keep]] <- srsf2_calls$SRSF2_genotype_nano[keep]
```

```{r modalities per patient}
# --- cohort setup ---
patients <- paste0("P", 1:17)
modalities <- c("scRNAseq", "WES","nanoranger")
nanoranger_full   <- paste0("P", c(1,2,3,4,6,7,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16,17))
nanoranger_partial <- paste0("P", c(5,9))  # only genotyped for SRSF2
wes_missing <- paste0("P", c(5,8,9))
status_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(Modality = modalities, Patient = patients) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = case_when(
      Modality == "scRNAseq" ~ "scRNA-seq",
      Modality == "WES" & Patient %in% wes_missing ~ "not available",
      Modality == "WES" ~ "WES",
      Modality == "nanoranger" & Patient %in% nanoranger_partial ~ "nanoranger",
      Modality == "nanoranger" & Patient %in% nanoranger_full ~ "nanoranger",
      TRUE ~ "not available"
    ),
    Status = factor(
      Status,
      levels = c("scRNA-seq", "WES", "nanoranger", "not available")
    ),
    Patient = factor(Patient, levels = patients),
    Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("scRNAseq", "WES", "nanoranger"))
  )

# ── main plot (no legend, no modality labels) ──────────────────────────────────
p_main <- ggplot(status_df, aes(x = Patient, y = Modality, fill = Status)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, width = 0.9, height = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "scRNA-seq" = "#1b9e77",
      "WES" = "#7570b3",
      "nanoranger" = "#d95f02",
      "not available" = "#d9d9d9"
    ),
    breaks = c("scRNA-seq", "WES", "nanoranger", "not available"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = patients) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(c("scRNAseq", "WES", "nanoranger"))) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTDIR, "project_status_heatmap_cohort2_horizontal.png"),
  plot = p_main,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTDIR, "project_status_heatmap_cohort2_horizontal.pdf"),
  plot = p_main,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "white"
)

# ── legend extracted separately ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

p_for_legend <- p_main +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14)
  )

p_legend_only <- ggpubr::get_legend(p_for_legend)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTDIR, "project_status_heatmap_cohort2_horizontal_legend.pdf"),
  plot = ggpubr::as_ggplot(p_legend_only),
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r blast count}
blast_df <- data.frame(
  patient = c("P1","P2","P3","P4","P5","P6","P7","P8","P9", "P10", "P11", "P12", "P16"),
  blast_pct = c(50, 30, 80, 70, 40, 80, 25, 70, 40, 95, 90, 14, 20)
)

# order patients low -> high, bottom -> top
blast_df <- blast_df %>%
  dplyr::arrange(blast_pct) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(patient = factor(patient, levels = patient))

p_blast <- ggplot(blast_df, aes(x = blast_pct, y = patient, fill = blast_pct)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDE0DC", high = "#B2182B") +

  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  xlab("Blast count (%)")

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR, "blast_count_dummy_barplot.pdf"),
  p_blast, width = 5, height = 4, units = "cm", useDingbats = FALSE
)
```

```{r oncoplot}
# 1) AML driver genes
aml_driver_genes <- c(
  "ABL1","ASXL1","ASXL2","ATRX","BCOR","BCORL1","BRAF",
  "CBL","CBLB","CDKN2A","CEBPA","CSF3R","CUX1","DDX41","DNMT3A",
  "ETNK1","ETV6","EZH2","FBXW7","FLT3","GATA2","GNAS","HRAS",
  "IDH1","IDH2","IKZF1","JAK2","KMT2A","KDM6A","KIT","KRAS",
  "MPL","MYD88","MYC","NF1","NOTCH1","NPM1","NRAS","PDGFRA",
  "PHF6","PPM1D","PTPN11","RAD21","RUNX1","SETBP1","SF3B1",
  "SMC1A","SMC3","SRSF2","MFSD11","STAG2","TET2","TP53",
  "U2AF1","WT1","ZBTB7A","ZRSR2"
)

expected_samples <- paste0("P", 1:17)
wes_samples      <- base::intersect(expected_samples, unique(wes_info$SAMPLE_ID))
no_wes_samples   <- dplyr::setdiff(expected_samples, wes_samples)

present_long <- wes_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(SAMPLE_ID %in% wes_samples, FILTER == "PASS", gene %in% aml_driver_genes) %>%
  distinct(SAMPLE_ID, gene) %>%
  mutate(present = 1L)

wes_binary_long <- tidyr::expand_grid(SAMPLE_ID = wes_samples, gene = aml_driver_genes) %>%
  left_join(present_long, by = c("SAMPLE_ID", "gene")) %>%
  mutate(present = ifelse(is.na(present), 0L, present))

# ── Panel-only mutations for samples with NO WES data ─────────────────────────
no_wes_mutations <- list(
  P5 = c("SRSF2", "DNMT3A", "IDH1"),
  P8 = c("SRSF2", "TET2"),
  P9 = c("SRSF2", "IDH2", "TET2")
)

no_wes_long <- tidyr::expand_grid(SAMPLE_ID = no_wes_samples, gene = aml_driver_genes) %>%
  mutate(present = NA_integer_) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(present = ifelse(gene %in% no_wes_mutations[[SAMPLE_ID]], 1L, present)) %>%
  ungroup()

binary_long_all <- bind_rows(wes_binary_long, no_wes_long) %>%
  mutate(
    SAMPLE_ID = factor(SAMPLE_ID, levels = expected_samples),
    gene      = factor(gene, levels = aml_driver_genes)
  )

bin_mat <- binary_long_all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = SAMPLE_ID, values_from = present) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(bin_mat) <- "numeric"
bin_mat <- bin_mat[, paste0("P", 1:17)]

# ── Extra panel-detected mutations for samples that DO have WES ───────────────
extra_panel_mutations <- list(
  P6 = c("FLT3"),          # FLT3-ITD
  P7 = c("NPM1", "NRAS")
)

for (samp in names(extra_panel_mutations)) {
  genes_to_add <- extra_panel_mutations[[samp]]
  bin_mat[genes_to_add, samp] <- 1L
}

# Filter to mutated genes only
gene_freq <- rowSums(bin_mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
bin_mat   <- bin_mat[gene_freq > 0, , drop = FALSE]
gene_freq <- gene_freq[gene_freq > 0]

# ── Row order: SRSF2 first, then the rest by DESCENDING prevalence ────────────
# (ties broken alphabetically for stable, reproducible ordering)
other_genes_freq <- gene_freq[base::setdiff(names(gene_freq), "SRSF2")]
other_genes      <- names(other_genes_freq)[order(-other_genes_freq, other_genes_freq %>% names())]
row_order        <- c("SRSF2", other_genes)
bin_mat          <- bin_mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
gene_freq        <- gene_freq[row_order]

# ── Row labels: "GENE (n/N)" ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_wes <- length(wes_samples)
row_labels <- paste0(rownames(bin_mat), "  (", gene_freq[rownames(bin_mat)], "/", n_wes, ")")

# ── Colors (no legend) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
col_fun <- c("0" = "#F0F0F0", "1" = "#C0392B")
na_col  <- "#BDBDBD"

# ── Main heatmap ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ht <- Heatmap(
  bin_mat,
  name                  = "mut",
  col                   = col_fun,
  na_col                = na_col,
  cluster_rows          = FALSE,
  cluster_columns       = FALSE,

  show_column_names     = TRUE,
  column_names_side     = "top",
  column_names_rot      = 0,
  column_names_gp       = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_centered = TRUE,

  show_row_names        = TRUE,
  row_names_side        = "left",
  row_names_gp          = gpar(fontsize = 8.5, fontface = "italic"),

  rect_gp               = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),
  border                = FALSE,
  show_heatmap_legend   = FALSE
)

# ── Save (fixed 9 cm x 6 cm) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
pdf(file.path(OUTDIR, "oncoplot_binary_srsf2cohort.pdf"), width = 11 / 2.54, height = 7 / 2.54)
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "mm"))
dev.off()

png(file.path(OUTDIR, "oncoplot_binary_srsf2cohort.png"), width = 9, height = 6, units = "cm", res = 350)
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "mm"))
dev.off()
```

```{r UMAPs cell types and SRSF2 genotype}
# SRSF2 genotype: obj$SRSF2_genotype_nano (assigned in the setup chunk)
cat("SRSF2 genotype distribution:\n")
print(table(obj$SRSF2_genotype_nano))

# ============================================================
# 1. Shared theme (no legend, no axis text/ticks)
# ============================================================
umap_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_blank(),
    axis.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    panel.border    = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ============================================================
# 2. Build shared plot dataframe
# ============================================================
emb <- Embeddings(obj, reduction = "umap_projected")[, 1:2]
df_base <- data.frame(
  UMAP_1   = emb[, 1],
  UMAP_2   = emb[, 2],
  sample   = as.character(obj$sample),
  celltype = as.character(obj$BoneMarrowMap_CellType_Broad_final),
  genotype = as.character(obj$SRSF2_genotype_nano),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 3. Colors (celltype_colors: setup chunk)
# ============================================================
geno_colors <- c(
  "mutated"  = "firebrick",
  "wildtype" = "black",
  "unknown"  = "lightgrey"
)

# ============================================================
# 4. Draw order for genotype plot
# ============================================================
set.seed(1)
df_geno_unknown <- df_base[df_base$genotype == "unknown", ]
df_geno_known   <- df_base[df_base$genotype %in% c("wildtype", "mutated"), ]
df_geno_known   <- df_geno_known[sample.int(nrow(df_geno_known)), ]
df_geno         <- rbind(df_geno_unknown, df_geno_known)

# ============================================================
# 5. Build each UMAP (celltype + genotype only, no legends)
# ============================================================
p_celltype <- ggplot(df_base, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = celltype)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.00001, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") + ylab("UMAP 2") +
  umap_theme

p_geno <- ggplot(df_geno, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = genotype)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.00001, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = geno_colors, drop = FALSE,
                     limits = c("mutated", "wildtype", "unknown")) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") + ylab("UMAP 2") +
  umap_theme

# ============================================================
# 6. Save each UMAP individually, identical dimensions
# ============================================================
PANEL_WIDTH  <- 14
PANEL_HEIGHT <- 13

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR, "srsf2_umap_celltype.pdf"),
  p_celltype,
  width = PANEL_WIDTH, height = PANEL_HEIGHT, units = "cm",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR, "srsf2_umap_genotype.pdf"),
  p_geno,
  width = PANEL_WIDTH, height = PANEL_HEIGHT, units = "cm",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)
```

```{r cell-type composition, SRSF2 genotype and genotyped fraction per patient}
# ============================================================
# PART 1 — CELL TYPE COMPOSITION (17 samples) — master order
# ============================================================

samples_to_include <- c(
  "P5", "P14", "P17", "P9", "P7", "P6", "P10", "P16",
  "P1", "P12", "P2", "P15", "P13", "P3", "P11", "P4", "P8"
)

celltype_order <- c(
  "HSCs", "GMPs", "Monocytes", "Dendritic cells", "MEPs",
  "Erythroid-like cells", "Lymphoid progenitors", "T-cells",
  "B-cells", "Plasma cells", "NK cells", "Stromal cells"
)

celltype_df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample    = as.character(sample),
    cell_type = as.character(BoneMarrowMap_CellType_Broad_final)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample %in% samples_to_include) %>%
  dplyr::count(sample, cell_type, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = celltype_order))

group_scores <- celltype_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      cell_type == "HSCs"                                       ~ "HSC-like",
      cell_type %in% c("GMPs", "Monocytes")                     ~ "GMP/Monocytic-like",
      cell_type %in% c("MEPs", "Erythroid-like cells")          ~ "MEP/Erythroid-like",
      cell_type %in% c("Lymphoid progenitors", "T-cells",
                        "B-cells", "NK cells")                  ~ "Lymphoid-like",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample, group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(group_pct = sum(pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = group_pct, values_fill = 0)

sample_classification <- group_scores %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "group", values_to = "group_pct") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(group_pct, n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c(
      "HSC-like", "GMP/Monocytic-like", "MEP/Erythroid-like", "Lymphoid-like"
    ))
  )

# MASTER 17-sample order — drives panel 1 AND panel 3
celltype_sample_order <- sample_classification %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group, dplyr::desc(group_pct)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(sample)

celltype_df <- celltype_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = celltype_sample_order))

print(sample_classification)

# ============================================================
# PART 2 — SRSF2 NANORANGER GENOTYPING (16 samples; P8 = phantom)
# ============================================================

geno_samples <- unique(srsf2_nano$sample_name[srsf2_nano$gene == "SRSF2"])

meta_lookup <- obj@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    orig.ident = as.character(orig.ident),
    sample     = as.character(sample)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, orig.ident, sample)

recurrent_genes <- c(
  "SRSF2", "ASXL1", "TET2", "RUNX1", "STAG2", "IDH2", "NPM1", "CBL",
  "CEBPA", "CSF3R", "CUX1", "ETNK1", "GATA2", "IDH1", "JAK2", "MYC",
  "NRAS", "PTPN11", "SETBP1"
)

total_cells_per_sample <- meta_lookup %>%
  dplyr::count(sample, name = "n_total_cells")

cell_category <- srsf2_nano %>%
  dplyr::filter(mutated %in% c("mutated", "wildtype")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    bc          = as.character(bc),
    sample_name = as.character(sample_name),
    gene        = as.character(gene)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample_name, bc, gene) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_name, bc) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    has_recurrent = any(gene %in% recurrent_genes),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(category = ifelse(has_recurrent, "recurrent", "non-recurrent")) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(meta_lookup, by = c("bc" = "cell", "sample_name" = "orig.ident")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample, bc, category)

geno_counts <- cell_category %>%
  dplyr::count(sample, category, name = "n")

total_df <- geno_counts %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(total_cells_per_sample, by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(`non-genotyped` = n_total_cells - recurrent - `non-recurrent`) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c("recurrent", "non-recurrent", "non-genotyped"),
    names_to = "category", values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / n_total_cells)

# Panel 2's OWN order (ascending fraction genotyped) — unchanged
total_sample_order <- total_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(category != "non-genotyped") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(pct_genotyped_total = sum(pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pct_genotyped_total) %>%
  dplyr::pull(sample)

total_df <- total_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample %in% total_sample_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(category = factor(category, levels = c("non-genotyped", "non-recurrent", "recurrent")))

# Pad panel 2 to 17 x-axis slots (phantom = P8) so bar widths match panel 1
phantom_total <- setdiff(celltype_sample_order, total_sample_order)
total_levels_17 <- c(total_sample_order, phantom_total)
total_df <- total_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = total_levels_17))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SRSF2-only genotype (mutated/wildtype) per sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (obj$SRSF2_genotype_nano is assigned in the setup chunk)

df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    orig.ident = as.character(orig.ident),
    sample     = as.character(sample)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    orig.ident %in% geno_samples,
    SRSF2_genotype_nano %in% c("mutated", "wildtype")
  )

count_df <- df %>%
  dplyr::count(sample, SRSF2_genotype_nano) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample %in% total_sample_order) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Add explicit "not genotyped" bar for P8 (100% of its slot)
p8_not_genotyped <- tibble::tibble(
  sample               = "P8",
  SRSF2_genotype_nano  = "not genotyped",
  n                    = NA_integer_,
  pct                  = 100
)

# Panel 3 order = SAME order as panel 1 (celltype plot)
count_df <- count_df %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(p8_not_genotyped) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample = factor(sample, levels = celltype_sample_order),
    SRSF2_genotype_nano = factor(
      SRSF2_genotype_nano,
      levels = c("wildtype", "mutated", "not genotyped")
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# THEME + COLORS
# ============================================================
bar_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

geno_colors <- c(
  wildtype        = "black",
  mutated         = "firebrick",
  "not genotyped" = "lightgrey"
)

total_colors <- c("non-genotyped" = "grey85", "non-recurrent" = "#E69F00", "recurrent" = "#0072B2")

# ============================================================
# PANELS
# scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) forces every panel to have exactly
# 17 x-axis slots, even where only 16 samples have real data ->
# identical bar width across all three panels at identical panel width.
# ============================================================
p_celltype <- ggplot(celltype_df, aes(x = sample, y = pct, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100.5)) +
  bar_theme

p_total <- ggplot(total_df, aes(x = sample, y = pct, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = total_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100.5)) +
  bar_theme

p_srsf2 <- ggplot(count_df, aes(x = sample, y = pct, fill = SRSF2_genotype_nano)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = geno_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100.5)) +
  bar_theme

# ============================================================
# COMBINE — each panel at the celltype plot's own size (10 x 6.5 cm),
# stacked vertically, one below the other
# ============================================================
combined_plot <- p_celltype / p_srsf2 / p_total +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1))

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR, "combined_celltype_total_srsf2_barplot.pdf"),
  combined_plot, width = 10, height = 19.5, units = "cm", useDingbats = FALSE
)
ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR, "combined_celltype_total_srsf2_barplot.png"),
  combined_plot, width = 10, height = 19.5, units = "cm", dpi = 300
)

# ============================================================
# LEGEND (celltype plot only, extracted separately)
# ============================================================
p_celltype_legend_source <- ggplot(celltype_df, aes(x = sample, y = pct, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

p_celltype_legend <- ggpubr::get_legend(p_celltype_legend_source)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR, "celltype_fractions_legend.pdf"),
  p_celltype_legend, width = 6, height = 8, units = "cm", useDingbats = FALSE
)
```

```{r percent mutated cells per compartment}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Collapse NanoRanger calls to per-cell mutated_any
# ------------------------------------------------------------
nano_by_cell <- srsf2_nano %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(bc),
    mutated %in% c("mutated", "wildtype"),
    in_seurat == TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    bc          = as.character(bc),
    sample_name = as.character(sample_name)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_name, bc) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mutated_any = any(mutated == "mutated"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Map orig.ident -> patient from Seurat
# ------------------------------------------------------------
sample_map <- obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(orig.ident, sample) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    orig.ident = as.character(orig.ident),
    patient    = as.character(sample)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Join NanoRanger cells with Seurat metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------
meta_df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell       = as.character(cell),
    orig.ident = as.character(orig.ident),
    celltype   = as.character(BoneMarrowMap_CellType_Broad_final)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, orig.ident, celltype)

geno_origidents <- unique(nano_by_cell$sample_name)

joined <- meta_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(orig.ident %in% geno_origidents) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    nano_by_cell,
    by = c("cell" = "bc", "orig.ident" = "sample_name")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_map, by = "orig.ident") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(celltype), !is.na(patient))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Per patient x celltype: % mutated
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pct_df <- joined %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient, celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_genotyped = dplyr::n_distinct(cell),
    mutated_cells   = dplyr::n_distinct(cell[mutated_any]),
    pct_mutated     = 100 * mutated_cells / total_genotyped,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(pct_mutated),
    total_genotyped >= 10    # minimum cells threshold for reliability
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Celltype colors + enforced order (Plasma cells & Stromal cells omitted)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cluster_colors <- c(
  "HSCs"                 = "#d24163",
  "GMPs"                 = "#4d8445",
  "Lymphoid progenitors" = "#3e2664",
  "MEPs"                 = "darkorange",
  "Erythroid-like cells" = "#bd7533",
  "Monocytes"            = "#5bb94d",
  "Dendritic cells"      = "#a1af47",
  "T-cells"              = "#8DA0CB",
  "B-cells"              = "#A6761D",
  "NK cells"             = "#c959ad"
)

celltype_levels <- names(cluster_colors)

pct_df <- pct_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype %in% celltype_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Compute median per celltype for annotation
# ------------------------------------------------------------
median_df <- pct_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_patients = dplyr::n(),
    median_pct = median(pct_mutated, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(pct_df, aes(x = celltype, y = pct_mutated, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth     = 0.3,
    color         = "black",
    alpha         = 0.55,
    width         = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_beeswarm(
    aes(fill = celltype),
    cex       = 2.5,
    size      = 0.8,
    alpha     = 0.75,
    color     = "black",
    shape     = 21,
    stroke    = 0.2
  ) +
  # Annotate n per celltype at the bottom
  geom_text(
    data    = median_df,
    aes(x = celltype, y = -4, label = paste0("n=", n_patients)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size    = 2.2,
    color   = "grey30",
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(-7, 102),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = paste0(seq(0, 100, 25), "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "% Mutated cells"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 4)),
    axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none",
    plot.margin      = margin(2, 2, 1, 2, "mm")
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Save
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR, "NanoRanger_pct_mutated_per_celltype_boxplot.pdf"),
  p, width = 9, height = 6, units = "cm", useDingbats = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR, "NanoRanger_pct_mutated_per_celltype_boxplot.png"),
  p, width = 9, height = 6, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
```
